Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: No service between Paddington and Elephant & Castle while we respond to a fire alert at Piccadilly Circus. Tickets being accepted on London Buses and Thameslink. SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line.

Circle.reason: CIRCLE LINE: Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 September, no service between Edgware Road and Aldgate (via Victoria)

District.reason: DISTRICT LINE: Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 September, no service between Tower Hill / Edgware Road and Ealing Broadway / Kensington (Olympia) / Richmond / Wimbledon. Use MILDMAY LINE services between Gunnersbury and Richmond on Saturday. Replacement buses operate. If travelling to Chelsea vs Hull City AFC at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, please use PICCADILLY LINE services at Earls Court.

Elizabeth line.reason: Severe delays Hayes & Harlington and Reading due to vandalism to equipment in the Paddington area. MINOR DELAYS Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Hammersmith & City.reason: Hammersmith and City Line: Severe delays due to a points failure at Tower Hill. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses and the Elizabeth line.

Lioness.reason: Lioness Line: No service between Watford Junction and Willesden Junction due to a sewage leak on the track at Watford High Street. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line. London Underground is accepting tickets via reasonable route.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Baker Street and Aldgate and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to a collapsed drain on the track at Baker Street. Tickets being accepted on London Buses and Chiltern railway services.

Northern.reason: Northern Line: Minor delays due to an earlier fire alert at Mornington Crescent.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Severe delays between Acton Town and Cockfosters due to a signal failure at Bounds Green. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line. Tickets will be accepted on local buses.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.
